crossRefs.note: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war, and have shed blood.’
You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”
You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
“You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of Yahweh his God because of the wars which were…
“Go and tell David my servant, ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;
“Go and tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?

translations.web: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly, and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.
translations.bsb: but this word of the LORD came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.
translations.kjv: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
translations.asv: But the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build a house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
